decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out the numerous cases and power adapters in the feed to focus on actual speakers. My consideration set included a range of products from premium brands (Bose), reliable mid-range options (JBL, Philips), and budget/aesthetic choices (MusiBaby, Rerii). I ultimately chose the JBL Clip 3 because it has an exceptional rating (4.7) from a massive number of reviews, offering high confidence in its durability and performance for its $54.95 price point. The Bose was a strong contender but significantly more expensive, while the budget options had some mixed reviews regarding volume levels.
